result.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts the diff replaces `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration !== "google_calendar"` with `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` followed by `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"`. When destinationCalendar is null or an empty array (e.g. Google Meet selected without a destination calendar — exactly the case this fallback handles), the destructured variable is undefined and `.integration` throws a TypeError, whereas the old optional chaining was safe. The mechanism is fully visible in the diff.
